name: Consensus
one_liner: AI-powered scientific search engine (consensus.app) over 400M+ academic papers, with REST API (search, threads) and MCP server.
auth_notes: REST API: organization-scoped API key sent as Authorization: Bearer, issued from consensus.app/subscription/api. MCP server: OAuth 2.1 auth code + PKCE with dynamic client registration; limited anonymous tier.
access_notes: REST Search API is optional on Team and Enterprise plans 'available upon approval, rate limited' with pricing via consensus.app/home/api; Enterprise custom. MCP server with OAuth works with a free account (limited quotas).

buildability.rationale: REST API (GET /v1/search, POST /v1/threads) needs approval on a Team/Enterprise org subscription; only the OAuth MCP server is self-serve. OpenAPI spec was Cloudflare-blocked.

disputes.why: Official llms.txt and pricing describe the product, API and MCP server.
Official pricing.md says Search API access is available upon approval for Team/Enterprise.
llms-full.txt documents Bearer API keys and OAuth 2.1 for MCP.
Official MCP endpoint mcp.consensus.app/mcp documented on consensus.app.
API approval-gated; resolvable with official docs.

identity.quote: Consensus is an AI-powered scientific search engine that finds, ranks, and synthesizes peer-reviewed research

auth.quote: Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` on every request

access.quote: Optional access to the Consensus Search API (available upon approval, rate limited; see https://consensus.app/home/api/ for pricing)
Issued from the organization subscription page at https://consensus.app/subscription/api/

api_surface.quote: Search returns ranked papers in one call. Threads hands the whole research task to the Consensus agent.
When a limit is exceeded the API returns HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header.

buildability.quote: Optional access to the Consensus Search API with custom pricing and rate limits
